title: My Lasso device failed to scan or scans intermittently
body:
If your Lasso device failed to scan, is difficult to scan or scans intermittently, try the following troubleshooting steps, then reach out to us if they do not help. If your device is defective, we will replace it at no cost!

Test scanning your device by navigating to the Lasso app’s Settings > Device and tapping the ‘Add Device’ button. This allows you to test the scanning functionality without having to set and deal with an alarm. A successful scan should give you a ‘Device Already Paired’ message.

Hold the very top, back end of your iPhone up to the device. If your device is attached to a refrigerator or other metal surface, try removing it. If you have a thick case on your phone, try holding the Lasso device over your front facing camera instead of the back.
